title: Halal
lead: BOTIA found nothing on this label that would raise a question under Islamic dietary criteria. BOTIA is not a certification body and does not issue rulings.
disclaimer: BOTIA reads what the label declares. Always check important information yourself.
robot_questions: Is reading the ingredients enough to know whether a product is halal, or is a certification needed?
Which ingredients of variable origin make a list alone insufficient to decide whether something is halal?
